tweet.text: Participants were sourced from GitHub, academic department and conference-author directories, METR, METR staff’s professional networks, and X. Response rate was 2% outside METR staff and their networks (where response rates are higher), so our results plausibly suffer from significant selection bias. Respondents averaged 12 years programming, 19 months using AI for programming, and 7 months using agentic AI coding tools. 48% are US-based. 50% regularly use Claude Code.
